items.title: Evaluation of GFAP, UCH-L1 and S100B Blood Biomarkers for the Management of Sports-Related Concussion in Professional Rugby Players: A Prospective Observational Study
items.summary: A prospective observational study evaluated GFAP, UCH-L1, and S100B blood biomarkers for managing sports-related concussion in professional rugby players, highlighting their potential as objective assessment tools given the limitations of current protocols.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究表明 GFAP、UCH-L1 和 S100B 血液生物标志物可能在橄榄球运动员运动相关脑震荡的管理中发挥作用。未来，这些生物标志物可能辅助你评估高强度运动损伤，但目前临床应用仍需更多验证。
items.titleZh: GFAP、UCH-L1和S100B血液生物标志物在职业橄榄球运动员运动相关脑震荡管理中的评估：一项前瞻性观察性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究评估了GFAP、UCH-L1和S100B血液生物标志物在职业橄榄球运动员运动相关脑震荡管理中的作用，强调了它们作为客观评估工具的潜力，以弥补现有协议的局限性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests GFAP, UCH-L1, and S100B blood biomarkers may assist in managing sports-related concussions in rugby players. While promising for high-intensity sports injury assessment, further clinical validation is needed before widespread adoption.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对特定高强度运动（职业橄榄球）运动员的观察性研究，其结果的外推性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study focusing on professional rugby players, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Positional Therapy May Ease COPD Breathlessness, suggests research
items.summary: New research suggests that positional therapy may effectively ease breathlessness experienced by patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).
items.curatedReason: 这项新闻报道了体位疗法可能缓解慢阻肺患者呼吸困难的研究。虽然具体研究细节和证据强度未知，但可以提示你在临床上尝试不同体位来优化患者的呼吸舒适度，并关注相关研究进展。
items.titleZh: 研究表明体位疗法可能缓解慢阻肺（COPD）呼吸困难
items.summaryZh: 一项新研究表明，体位疗法可能有效缓解慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者的呼吸困难。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news reports on research suggesting positional therapy may ease breathlessness in COPD patients. While specific study details and evidence strength are unknown, it can prompt you to explore different positions to optimize patient breathing comfort and stay updated on relevant research.

items.title: Does surgical approach or preoperative deformity better predict outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures? A comparative study of minimally invasive versus open techniques
items.summary: A comparative study investigates whether surgical approach (minimally invasive vs. open) or preoperative deformity better predicts outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究比较了微创与开放技术治疗胸腰椎骨折的结局预测因素。在为胸腰椎骨折患者制定康复计划时，你应该了解外科手术方式和术前畸形对预后的影响，以便更好地与外科团队协作并管理患者预期。
items.titleZh: 胸腰椎骨折中，手术入路或术前畸形哪个更能预测预后？一项微创与开放技术的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较研究探讨了胸腰椎骨折中，是手术入路（微创 vs. 开放）还是术前畸形更能预测预后。
items.curatedReasonEn: For thoracolumbar fractures, preoperative deformity is a better predictor of rehabilitation outcomes than surgical approach (minimally invasive vs. open). When assessing these patients, considering preoperative deformity as a key factor may offer better insight into their functional recovery trajectory than focusing solely on the surgical approach.
items.limitation: 这是一项比较外科手术方法的研究，并未直接评估物理治疗干预的有效性或优化方案。
items.limitationEn: This study compares surgical approaches and does not directly evaluate the effectiveness or optimization of physical therapy interventions.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Call for applications: National committees of the Chinese Medicine Board of Australia
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) is inviting applications for national committee positions within the Chinese Medicine Board of Australia.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 正在招募澳大利亚中医药委员会的国家委员会成员，这是监管机构的常规活动，与物理治疗师的日常执业直接关联不大。如果你对参与多专业监管事务感兴趣，可以留意此类公告。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：招募澳大利亚中医药委员会国家委员会成员
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（AHPRA）正在招募澳大利亚中医药委员会的国家委员会成员。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) is seeking applications for national committee members of the Chinese Medicine Board of Australia. This is a routine regulatory activity and not directly relevant to physical therapists' daily practice. You may monitor such announcements if interested in multi-professional regulatory affairs.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra appoints new head of its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has announced the appointment of a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 任命了其原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。这项人事任命虽是机构动态，但其战略方向可能影响未来澳大利亚原住民社区的物理治疗服务可及性和文化适宜性，值得澳洲执业者关注。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门新负责人
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（AHPRA）宣布任命其原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has appointed a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit. While an internal appointment, the strategic direction of this unit may influence the accessibility and cultural appropriateness of physical therapy services for Aboriginal communities in Australia, warranting attention from practitioners there.

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Body Acupuncture, Electroacupuncture, and Auricular Acupuncture in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 21 RCTs found acupuncture significantly improved motor function in stroke survivors (SMD=6.48; 95% CI=4.72-8.24; P<0.001), with electroacupuncture showing the greatest benefit.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后运动功能障碍，针灸确有疗效，尤其电针获益最大。将电针纳入你的康复方案，作为常规治疗的有效补充，以期在运动功能改善上实现1+1>2。
items.titleZh: 体针、电针和耳针在卒中康复中的比较疗效：随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 21 项随机对照试验的系统综述发现，针灸显著改善了卒中幸存者的运动功能（SMD=6.48；95% CI=4.72-8.24；P<0.001），其中电针效果最佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke motor dysfunction, acupuncture is effective, with electroacupuncture showing the greatest benefit. Incorporate electroacupuncture into your rehabilitation protocols as an effective adjunct to conventional treatment, aiming for synergistic improvements in motor function.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的异质性可能影响结果的综合解释。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity among included studies may affect the comprehensive interpretation of results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Arm exercise training in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesized findings on arm exercise training for COPD patients, screening six databases to identify systematic reviews and meta-analyses to establish evidence levels for its effectiveness.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述总结了臂部运动训练在 COPD 患者中的证据。臂部训练是肺康复的重要组成部分，它强调了在制定 COPD 康复计划时，应将臂部训练作为常规手段纳入，以管理肺外表现。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者的臂部运动训练：系统综述和 Meta 分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述综合了关于 COPD 患者臂部运动训练的研究结果，通过筛选六个数据库，旨在确立其有效性的证据水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review synthesizes the evidence for arm exercise training in COPD patients. Arm training is a crucial component of pulmonary rehabilitation, emphasizing its routine inclusion in COPD rehab programs to manage extrapulmonary manifestations.
items.limitation: 伞形综述的质量依赖于其纳入的系统综述和 Meta 分析的质量，可能存在证据等级的局限。
items.limitationEn: The quality of an umbrella review depends on the quality of its included systematic reviews and meta-analyses, which may introduce limitations in the level of evidence.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper argues that physiotherapy is entering a post-professional era driven by the atomization of health, unbundling of professional claims, and digitally mediated technological disruption, leading to practitioner marginalization.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评警示了物理治疗行业可能面临的“后专业时代”挑战，包括算法化和数字化颠覆。它提醒你关注并思考技术和经济力量如何重塑物理治疗的实践和专业自主性。
items.titleZh: 当算法不再关心：物理治疗与“后专业时代”
items.summaryZh: 本文认为，物理治疗正在进入一个“后专业时代”，其特点是医疗服务碎片化、专业声誉去中心化以及数字化技术颠覆，导致临床医师在协调和提供护理中的边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary warns about the potential challenges of a "post-professional era" for physical therapy, including algorithmic and digital disruption. It prompts you to consider how technological and economic forces might reshape PT practice and professional autonomy.
items.limitation: 本研究为述评，其结论基于理论分析和观点，而非实证数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is a commentary; its conclusions are based on theoretical analysis and viewpoints, not empirical data.

items.title: Manifestations of Oral Muscle Mass, Tongue Strength, and Endurance in Patients with Stroke Across Varying Degrees of Swallowing Function: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot study of 41 stroke patients found correlations between oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance with varying degrees of swallowing function.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究揭示了卒中患者口部肌肉质量、舌肌力量和耐力与吞咽功能之间的关联。它提示你在评估卒中后吞咽障碍时，可将这些指标纳入考量，以更全面地理解患者状况。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者口部肌肉质量、舌肌力量和耐力在不同吞咽功能程度中的表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名卒中患者的初步研究发现，口部肌肉质量、弹性以及舌肌表现与不同程度的吞咽功能存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study reveals associations between oral muscle mass, tongue strength, and endurance with swallowing function in stroke patients. It suggests that you may consider these metrics when assessing post-stroke dysphagia for a more comprehensive understanding of the patient's condition.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本横断面观察研究，无法确立因果关系，且结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample cross-sectional observational study, which cannot establish causality and has limited generalizability.

items.title: Therapeutic Exercise Protocol During Hospitalization in Pediatric Oncohematological Patients: Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 30 pediatric oncohematological patients aged 8-17 evaluated the effects of a therapeutic exercise program on quality of life, muscle strength, fatigue, and functional capacity during hospitalization.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 强调了住院期间早期物理治疗对儿童肿瘤患者的重要性。它提示你，在针对这类特殊人群的康复中，及早介入治疗性运动方案有助于维持其功能和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 儿童血液肿瘤住院患者的治疗性运动方案：随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名 8-17 岁儿童血液肿瘤住院患者的随机临床试验，评估了治疗性运动方案对生活质量、肌肉力量、疲劳和功能能力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT highlights the importance of early physical therapy during hospitalization for pediatric oncohematological patients. It suggests that early intervention with therapeutic exercise protocols can help maintain function and quality of life in rehabilitation for this special population.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小，可能会影响结果的统计效力和普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, which may affect the statistical power and generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: From Injury to Inclusion: Evidence From the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI).
items.summary: By April 2026, the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI), with 12,591 Wave 1 and 15,249 Wave 2 participants, generated 117 peer-reviewed publications, primarily on healthcare needs and epidemiology.
items.curatedReason: 这项证据图谱全面梳理了国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的成果和知识空白。了解这些成果有助于你把握脊髓损伤康复领域的研究趋势和未来方向。
items.titleZh: 从损伤到融合：国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的证据
items.summaryZh: 截至 2026 年 4 月，国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）已发表 117 篇同行评审论文，其中第一波（12,591 名参与者）和第二波（15,249 名参与者）研究主要集中在医疗需求和流行病学。
items.curatedReasonEn: This evidence map comprehensively summarizes the findings and knowledge gaps from the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI). Understanding these findings helps you grasp research trends and future directions in spinal cord injury rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究是一个证据图谱，而非原创性研究，其价值在于汇总现有文献。
items.limitationEn: This study is an evidence map, not an original research project, and its value lies in synthesizing existing literature.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Neuralgic Amyotrophy Following Rotator Cuff Repair: A Patient's Experience.
items.summary: A 64-year-old male developed severe periscapular pain and weakness eight days post-arthroscopic rotator cuff repair due to neuralgic amyotrophy, showing slow but substantial functional recovery with prolonged physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 本病例报告描述了肩袖修复术后神经性肌萎缩的治疗过程。此类并发症不常见，但对肩部康复构成挑战，临床上需要关注并识别其特殊性。
items.titleZh: 肩袖修复术后神经性肌萎缩：一例患者经验
items.summaryZh: 一名 64 岁男性在关节镜肩袖修复术后 8 天出现严重的肩胛周围疼痛和无力，诊断为神经性肌萎缩，在长期物理治疗下功能恢复缓慢但显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report describes the treatment of neuralgic amyotrophy following rotator cuff repair. Such complications are uncommon but challenging for shoulder rehabilitation, requiring clinical awareness and recognition of its unique characteristics.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性非常有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a single case report, and the generalizability of its findings is very limited.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A 51-year-old woman received integrated rehabilitation, including aquatic therapy, after PCL avulsion injury reconstruction, showing improved knee pain and range of motion.
items.curatedReason: 本病例报告展示了后交叉韧带重建术后结合水疗的康复方案。水疗可降低关节负荷并辅助早期功能恢复，为重建术后的康复提供了一种有益的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 后交叉韧带重建术后结合水疗的综合康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名 51 岁女性在后交叉韧带撕脱伤重建术后接受了包括水疗在内的综合康复，膝关节疼痛和活动度均有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates a rehabilitation protocol integrating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction. Aquatic therapy can reduce joint loading and assist early functional recovery, offering a beneficial adjunct for post-reconstruction rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性非常有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a single case report, and the generalizability of its findings is very limited.

items.title: Effectiveness and feasibility of home-based physical exercise interventions for children and adolescents with chronic diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized evidence on the effectiveness and feasibility of home-based physical exercise interventions for children and adolescents with chronic diseases, finding improvements in aerobic capacity, functional capacity, muscle strength, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性病儿童和青少年，居家体育锻炼是有效的。这项高质量系统综述发现，它能改善有氧能力、功能、肌力和生活质量。以后制定儿科康复计划，完全可以把居家方案作为核心选项。
items.titleZh: 居家体育锻炼干预对慢性病儿童和青少年的有效性与可行性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 本系统综述和荟萃分析综合了居家体育锻炼干预对慢性病儿童和青少年在改善有氧能力、功能能力、肌肉力量和生活质量方面的有效性与可行性证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based exercise works for children and adolescents with chronic diseases. This high-quality systematic review confirms improvements in aerobic capacity, functional capacity, muscle strength, and quality of life. Moving forward, home-based programs should be a core component of your pediatric rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 部分研究报告质量评估结果不佳，可能影响证据的整体确定性。
items.limitationEn: Some studies showed suboptimal reporting quality, which may affect the overall certainty of the evidence.

items.title: Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale.
items.summary: A 12-item Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale (SPAS) was developed and validated using a multicenter design (n=415) to provide an activity-based patient-reported outcome measure with a hierarchical stepwise yes/no format for identifying the first threshold of difficulty during daily activities.
items.curatedReason: SPAS 是一个基于活动的肩部患者报告结局量表，采用层级式是/否格式，有望在日常临床中更直观地评估患者功能。它提供了一种标准化、易于解释的工具，助您更好地追踪肩部患者的进展。
items.titleZh: 肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS) 的开发与心理测量学验证
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心研究（n=415）开发并验证了 12 项肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS)，该量表采用基于活动的层级式是/否格式，旨在识别日常活动中首次出现困难的阈值。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SPAS is an activity-based shoulder patient-reported outcome measure using a hierarchical yes/no format, offering intuitive functional assessment in routine clinical practice. It provides a standardized, easily interpretable tool to better track shoulder patient progress.
items.limitation: 研究样本仅来自门诊物理治疗中心，可能限制其在其他设置（如住院或运动康复）的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study sample was drawn only from outpatient physical therapy centers, potentially limiting its generalizability to other settings like inpatient or sports rehabilitation.

items.title: Joint non-linear dose-response associations of device-measured physical activity and cardiorespiratory fitness with cardiovascular disease: a cohort and Mendelian randomisation study
items.summary: A UK Biobank cohort study (n=93,026) and Mendelian randomization assessed the non-linear joint dose-response associations of accelerometer-measured moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) and estimated cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) with incident cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项大样本研究通过队列和孟德尔随机化，量化了体力活动和心肺适能对心血管疾病风险的联合剂量-反应关系。其结果强化了心肺适能对于运动康复中风险评估和干预目标设定的重要性。
items.titleZh: 设备测量体力活动和心肺适能与心血管疾病的联合非线性剂量-反应关联：一项队列和孟德尔随机化研究
items.summaryZh: 一项英国生物样本库队列研究（n=93,026）和孟德尔随机化研究评估了加速计测量的中高强度体力活动 (MVPA) 和估计心肺适能 (CRF) 与心血管疾病 (CVD) 事件风险的联合非线性剂量-反应关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-scale study, using cohort and Mendelian randomization, quantifies the joint dose-response relationship between physical activity and cardiorespiratory fitness on cardiovascular disease risk. Its findings underscore the importance of cardiorespiratory fitness in risk assessment and intervention goal setting within exercise rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究使用估计的最大摄氧量 (VO2max) 作为心肺适能指标，可能存在测量误差。
items.limitationEn: The study used estimated maximal oxygen uptake (VO2max) as a measure of cardiorespiratory fitness, which may introduce measurement error.

items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: A cross-sectional observational study (n=20) compared finger-worn and wrist-worn accelerometers, finding finger-worn accelerometers to be a valid and more sensitive alternative for measuring real-world upper-limb motor performance in stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，指戴式加速计在测量卒中幸存者上肢真实世界表现方面与腕戴式加速计同样有效且更敏感。这为您评估卒中患者功能恢复提供了新的工具，尤其是在精细运动监测方面。
items.titleZh: 不仅仅是手臂运动：指戴式加速计为测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢表现提供了比腕戴式更有效和敏感的替代方案
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面观察研究（n=20）比较了指戴式和腕戴式加速计，发现指戴式加速计是测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢运动表现的有效且更敏感的替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that finger-worn accelerometers are equally valid and more sensitive than wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb performance in stroke survivors. This offers you a new tool for assessing stroke patient functional recovery, especially for fine motor monitoring.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=20)，且仅限于轻中度上肢障碍的卒中幸存者，可能限制其外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=20) and was limited to stroke survivors with mild-to-moderate upper-limb impairment, which may limit its generalizability.

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary synthesizes emerging evidence on how care process factors, such as timing of care, point of entry, and care pathway design, independently influence outcomes in physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 本述评梳理了影响腰痛物理治疗效果的流程因素，包括及时性、首诊类型和支付模式。这些非治疗性因素在临床实践中往往被忽视，但对患者结局有显著影响，提示您优化服务交付流程的重要性。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理流程因素如何塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 本述评探讨了护理流程因素（如护理及时性、初始提供者类型和护理路径设计）如何独立于具体治疗，影响物理治疗师管理腰痛的患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights crucial care process factors—timeliness, entry point, and payment models—that influence low back pain physical therapy outcomes. These often-overlooked non-treatment elements significantly impact patient recovery, urging you to optimize service delivery processes.

items.title: Intensive, Multi-Technology Rehabilitation Programme for Chronic Stroke Survivors: Outcomes of a Phase I Single-Arm Repeated-Measures Study.
items.summary: An 8-week, single-arm, repeated-measures study observed changes in motor recovery outcomes in chronic stroke survivors (n=20) participating in an intensive, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究展示了慢性卒中幸存者通过多技术康复方案改善运动功能的潜力。虽然是单臂研究，但其结果提示，结合多种技术能为长期卒中残障患者提供有效的康复路径。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者的强化多技术康复方案：一项 I 期单臂重复测量研究的结果
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的单臂重复测量研究观察了 20 名慢性卒中幸存者在参与强化、基于小组的多技术康复方案后运动恢复结局的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reveals the potential of multi-technology rehabilitation programs to improve motor function in chronic stroke survivors. While a single-arm study, its results suggest that integrating various technologies can offer an effective rehabilitation pathway for individuals with long-term stroke disability.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂设计，缺乏对照组，无法确证干预的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-arm design, lacking a control group, which prevents conclusive causal inferences about the intervention's effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Switzerland: the European crossroad of sports eligibility decision-making in athletes with cardiovascular conditions
items.summary: This commentary describes the evolution of sports participation decision-making for athletes with cardiovascular conditions in Switzerland, shifting from a paternalistic approach to one that integrates patient autonomy.
items.curatedReason: 在心血管疾病运动员的运动决策上，瑞士的经验提示我们：别再搞家长式作风了。未来在处理这类个案时，请务必将运动员的自主意愿纳入考量，平衡好安全与个人选择。
items.titleZh: 瑞士：心血管疾病运动员运动资格决策的欧洲十字路口
items.summaryZh: 本述评描述了瑞士在心血管疾病运动员运动资格决策中的演变，从家长式方法转向整合患者自主性的新模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: For athletes with cardiovascular conditions, Switzerland's shift in sports participation decision-making tells us to move beyond paternalism. Going forward, prioritize integrating the athlete's autonomy, balancing safety with individual choice.

items.title: Epistemic injustice in sports medicine: framing return-to-play beyond hard data
items.summary: This commentary discusses epistemic injustice in sports medicine, advocating for a broader return-to-play decision-making framework that integrates clinical, physiological, psychological, and ethical considerations beyond 'hard data.'
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了运动医学中 "认知不公" 的概念，并提出回归运动决策应超越客观数据，整合临床、生理、心理和伦理考量。这提醒您在指导运动员重返赛场时，要更全面地考虑多方利益与非量化因素。
items.titleZh: 运动医学中的认知不公：超越硬数据来构建重返运动决策
items.summaryZh: 本述评讨论了运动医学中的认知不公问题，主张建立一个更广泛的重返运动决策框架，整合临床、生理、心理和伦理考量，而非仅仅依赖“硬数据”。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the concept of 'epistemic injustice' in sports medicine, arguing that return-to-play decisions should integrate clinical, physiological, psychological, and ethical considerations beyond objective data. This reminds you to adopt a more holistic approach when guiding athletes back to sport, considering multiple stakeholders' interests and non-quantifiable factors.

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: An exploratory case series from the MACHINE trial (n=8) described cardiovascular and autonomic responses to body weight-supported treadmill training combined with active or sham transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation in individuals with chronic, motor-complete spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究报告了脊髓损伤患者经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性训练后的心血管和自主神经反应。结果提示该组合疗法可能对慢性脊髓损伤患者的心血管功能有潜在益处，值得进一步关注。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法的心血管和自主神经反应：MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: MACHINE 试验的一项探索性病例系列研究（n=8）描述了慢性完全运动性脊髓损伤患者在接受体重支持下跑步机训练结合主动或假性经皮脊髓电刺激后的心血管和自主神经反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reports cardiovascular and autonomic responses in spinal cord injury patients after transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy. The results suggest potential cardiovascular benefits for individuals with chronic spinal cord injury from this combined therapy, warranting further attention.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性病例系列，样本量极小 (n=8)，且缺乏明确的对照组分析，限制了结论的通用性和因果推断。
items.limitationEn: This exploratory case series had an extremely small sample size (n=8) and lacked clear control group analysis, limiting the generalizability and causal inference of its conclusions.

items.title: Need to train clinicians for physical activity and exercise interventions: a call to action
items.summary: This call to action highlights the critical need to train clinicians in physical activity and exercise interventions, noting their underuse despite being effective treatments for chronic diseases, often due to lack of awareness, training, and reimbursement.
items.curatedReason: 这篇呼吁强调了医疗系统内对临床医生进行体力活动和运动干预培训的紧迫性。作为物理治疗师，这呼应了你专业的核心价值，也提示了行业在提升全社会运动处方能力方面的责任和机会。
items.titleZh: 需要培训临床医生进行体力活动和运动干预：一项行动呼吁
items.summaryZh: 这篇行动呼吁强调了培训临床医生进行体力活动和运动干预的迫切性，指出尽管这些干预对慢性病有效，但由于缺乏认知、培训和报销等因素，其在临床实践中仍未得到充分利用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This call to action underscores the urgent need to train clinicians in physical activity and exercise interventions within healthcare systems. As a physical therapist, this resonates with your professional core values and highlights the profession's responsibility and opportunity to enhance society's exercise prescription capabilities.

items.title: Optimal 24-hour movement behaviour compositions across trimesters and risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy: the Pregnancy 24/7 cohort study
items.summary: The Pregnancy 24/7 cohort study (N=500) found optimal 24-hour movement behavior compositions, including moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA), light-intensity physical activity (LPA), sedentary behavior, and sleep, across trimesters are associated with lower risks of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现孕期 24 小时运动行为（MVPA、LPA、久坐和睡眠）与妊娠期高血压疾病 (HDP) 风险相关。你可以用这些发现来指导对孕妇的运动行为干预建议，重点是优化整体运动组合，而不仅仅是 MVPA。
items.titleZh: 孕期各阶段 24 小时运动行为组成与妊娠期高血压疾病风险：Pregnancy 24/7 队列研究
items.summaryZh: Pregnancy 24/7 队列研究（N=500）发现，孕期各阶段最佳的 24 小时运动行为组成，包括中高强度体力活动（MVPA）、低强度体力活动（LPA）、久坐行为和睡眠，与较低的妊娠期高血压疾病 (HDP) 风险相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that 24-hour movement behaviors (MVPA, LPA, sedentary, and sleep) during pregnancy are associated with the risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP). You can use these findings to guide exercise behavior intervention recommendations for pregnant patients, focusing on optimizing the overall movement composition, not just MVPA.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且研究人群规模相对较小 (N=500)。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it cannot establish causality, and the study population size (N=500) is relatively small.

items.title: Unlocking the potential of light-intensity physical activity for public health: a call to action for research
items.summary: This commentary advocates for increased research and recognition of light-intensity physical activity (LPA) in public health guidelines, noting its ubiquity in daily life and potential health benefits, despite historical oversight in research.
items.curatedReason: 低强度体力活动（LPA）的益处可能被我们长期低估了。这份述评提醒我们，不该只盯着中高强度活动，LPA 也能带来健康改善，特别是对那些难以坚持高强度运动的患者。在日常宣教中，LPA 应该是你提供给患者的重要“入门级”选项。
items.titleZh: 挖掘低强度体力活动对公共卫生的潜力：一项研究呼吁
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评呼吁加强对低强度体力活动 (LPA) 的研究和重视，将其纳入公共卫生指南，指出 LPA 在日常生活中普遍存在且具潜在健康益处，尽管其在研究中长期被忽视。
items.curatedReasonEn: Light-intensity physical activity (LPA) benefits are likely underestimated. This commentary reminds us that we shouldn't solely focus on moderate-to-vigorous activity; LPA can also improve health, especially for patients struggling with higher intensities. LPA should be a key 'entry-level' option you offer patients in daily practice.

items.title: Evaluating movement breaks as a public health strategy to mitigate the harms of prolonged sitting: a large-scale pragmatic intervention
items.summary: A large-scale pragmatic intervention (N=19,342) embedded in a podcast found that 5-minute walking breaks, particularly every 30 minutes, are feasible and effective in improving psychosocial outcomes and reducing fatigue, supporting their role as a public health strategy against prolonged sitting.
items.curatedReason: 这项对近两万人进行的实际干预研究支持将短暂运动休息作为缓解久坐危害的公共卫生策略。你可以直接将“每 30 分钟休息 5 分钟”的频率纳入你对高久坐风险患者的建议，因为它在真实世界中显示出高可行性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 评估运动休息作为缓解久坐危害的公共卫生策略：一项大规模实践干预研究
items.summaryZh: 一项嵌入交互式播客的大规模实践干预（N=19,342）发现，短暂的 5 分钟步行休息，尤其是每 30 分钟一次，对于改善心理社会结果和减轻疲劳是可行且有效的，支持其作为对抗久坐的公共卫生策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pragmatic intervention study with nearly 20,000 participants supports brief movement breaks as a public health strategy to mitigate the harms of prolonged sitting. You can directly incorporate the "5-minute break every 30 minutes" frequency into your recommendations for patients at high risk of sedentary behavior, as it demonstrated high feasibility and effectiveness in a real-world setting.
items.limitation: 研究依赖参与者自我选择的休息频率，且可能存在自我选择偏倚，这会影响其对一般人群的推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on self-selected break frequencies and may be subject to self-selection bias, which could limit its generalizability to the broader population.

items.title: Resting and exercise-induced occult hypertension and coronary atherosclerosis in male masters endurance athletes
items.summary: Among 198 male masters endurance athletes with low Framingham risk, 39% had occult resting hypertension and 47% had exercise-induced hypertension, both significantly associated with coronary atherosclerosis characteristics, including higher coronary artery calcification (CAC) scores and high-risk plaque features.
items.titleZh: 男性资深耐力运动员的静息和运动诱发隐匿性高血压与冠状动脉粥样硬化
items.summaryZh: 在 198 名 Framingham 风险评分较低的男性资深耐力运动员中，39% 存在隐匿性静息高血压，47% 存在运动诱发高血压。两者均与冠状动脉粥样硬化特征显著相关，包括较高的冠状动脉钙化 (CAC) 评分和高风险斑块特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that occult hypertension (resting or exercise-induced) is associated with coronary atherosclerosis in male masters endurance athletes. When evaluating this population, you should consider 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring and exercise blood pressure assessment beyond routine checks to screen for potential risks.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于低 Framingham 风险评分的男性资深耐力运动员，结果可能不适用于其他人群。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to male masters endurance athletes with a low Framingham risk score, and results may not be generalizable to other populations.

items.title: Dual-pillar phenotype of elite deaf female soccer players: reduced aerobic capacity and repeated-sprint ability coexisting with enhanced explosive power
items.summary: A cross-sectional study comparing 18 elite deaf female soccer players with 21 hearing players found deaf athletes had reduced aerobic capacity (VO2max) and repeated-sprint ability but enhanced explosive power (CMJ), suggesting a dual-pillar phenotype.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现精英聋人女足球运动员在有氧能力和重复冲刺能力方面存在不足，但爆发力增强。在为聋人运动员设计训练方案时，你应该针对性地强化其心肺耐力和冲刺表现，并利用其增强的爆发力。
items.titleZh: 精英聋人女足球运动员的双重表型：有氧能力和重复冲刺能力降低与爆发力增强并存
items.summaryZh: 一项比较 18 名精英聋人女足球运动员与 21 名听力正常运动员的横断面研究发现，聋人运动员的有氧能力 (VO2max) 和重复冲刺能力降低，但爆发力（CMJ）增强，提示存在双重表型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found elite deaf female soccer players have reduced aerobic capacity and repeated-sprint ability but enhanced explosive power. When designing training programs for deaf athletes, you should specifically target improvements in cardiorespiratory endurance and sprint performance while leveraging their enhanced explosive power.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality, and the sample size is relatively small.

items.title: Infographic. Active commuting is linked to lower coronary atherosclerosis
items.summary: This infographic summarizes findings from a population-based study indicating that active commuting (walking or cycling to work) is associated with a lower risk of early coronary atherosclerosis, highlighting its role in cardiovascular disease prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这项信息图强调了主动通勤（步行或骑行上班）与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化风险相关。作为物理治疗师，你可以将主动通勤作为一种简单易行的体力活动融入你对患者的日常建议中，特别是在心血管疾病预防方面。
items.titleZh: 信息图：主动通勤与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化相关
items.summaryZh: 本信息图总结了一项基于人群的研究结果，表明主动通勤（步行或骑自行车上班）与较低的早期冠状动脉粥样硬化风险相关，强调了其在心血管疾病预防中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This infographic highlights the link between active commuting (walking or cycling to work) and lower coronary atherosclerosis risk. As a physical therapist, you can integrate active commuting as a simple, accessible physical activity into your daily recommendations for patients, especially for cardiovascular disease prevention.

items.title: Role of exercise in improving bone health in young paediatric patients with a history of cancer (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD thesis aimed to assess the impact of resistance exercise with high-impact loading and movement behaviors on bone health in young pediatric patients with a history of cancer, given their high risk of low areal bone mineral density.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究强调了负重抵抗运动对患癌儿童骨骼健康的益处。你应该意识到这些患者的骨骼脆弱性，并将其纳入你的干预考量，强调早期和适当的负重训练以改善骨密度。
items.titleZh: 运动在改善有癌症史的儿童患者骨骼健康中的作用（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士论文旨在评估负重抵抗运动和运动行为对有癌症史的年轻儿童患者骨骼健康的影响，因为他们患低骨密度风险较高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research highlights the benefits of resistance exercise with high-impact loading for bone health in pediatric cancer survivors. You should be aware of the bone fragility in these patients and incorporate it into your intervention considerations, emphasizing early and appropriate weight-bearing training to improve bone mineral density.

items.title: High-intensity circuit training combined with sleep or dietary interventions improves cardiometabolic health, sleep health and executive function (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD thesis investigated the effects of high-intensity circuit training (HICT), alone or combined with sleep or dietary interventions (time-restricted eating or Mediterranean diet), on cardiometabolic health, sleep, and executive function in women across multiple studies.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究发现高强度循环训练 (HICT) 结合睡眠或饮食干预可以改善女性的心脏代谢健康、睡眠和执行功能。你可以将 HICT 作为有效的运动干预手段，并考虑结合生活方式指导，以获得更全面的临床效果。
items.titleZh: 高强度循环训练结合睡眠或饮食干预可改善心脏代谢健康、睡眠健康和执行功能（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士论文通过多项研究，探讨了高强度循环训练 (HICT) 单独或结合睡眠或饮食干预（限时饮食或地中海饮食）对女性心脏代谢健康、睡眠和执行功能的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research found that high-intensity circuit training (HICT) combined with sleep or dietary interventions can improve cardiometabolic health, sleep, and executive function in women. You can use HICT as an effective exercise intervention and consider integrating lifestyle guidance for more comprehensive clinical outcomes.

items.title: Prospective Physical Activity, Sitting and Sleep consortium (ProPASS): addressing methodological and geographical barriers to inform global public health guidelines, interventions and precision medicine
items.summary: The Prospective Physical Activity, Sitting and Sleep consortium (ProPASS) aims to address methodological and geographical barriers in research on physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep by using objective measures to inform global public health guidelines.
items.curatedReason: ProPASS 联盟旨在通过客观测量手段克服自我报告数据在体力活动、久坐行为和睡眠研究中的局限性。未来由此产生的高质量数据会直接影响你所依赖的临床指南和干预策略。
items.titleZh: ProPASS 联盟：克服方法学和地理障碍，为全球公共卫生指南、干预和精准医学提供信息
items.summaryZh: ProPASS（体力活动、久坐和睡眠前瞻性联盟）旨在通过客观测量方法，克服体力活动、久坐行为和睡眠研究中的方法学和地理障碍，从而为全球公共卫生指南提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ProPASS consortium aims to overcome limitations of self-reported data in physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep research using objective measures. The high-quality data generated will directly influence the clinical guidelines and intervention strategies you rely on.

items.title: Exploring the effects of exogenous ketosis on physiological adaptation to exercise in hypoxia(PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD research explored the potential of exogenous ketosis (EK) to mitigate adverse effects and augment beneficial hypoxic adaptation during exercise in hypoxia, investigating underlying physiological and muscular mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究探索了外源性酮症对运动适应和高原缺氧影响的机制。尽管目前仍是基础研究，但未来若能明确其临床应用，可能会为你在特定高海拔或缺氧环境下的患者提供新的辅助干预策略。
items.titleZh: 探索外源性酮症对缺氧运动生理适应的影响（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士研究探索了外源性酮症 (EK) 在缺氧运动中减轻不良影响和增强有利缺氧适应的潜力，并调查了其潜在的生理和肌肉机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research explores the mechanisms of exogenous ketosis on exercise adaptation and the effects of hypoxia at altitude. Although currently basic research, if its clinical applications become clear in the future, it could offer new auxiliary intervention strategies for your patients in specific high-altitude or hypoxic environments.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $90 million to Modernize and Improve IT and Interoperability for South Dakota
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $90 million grant to modernize and improve IT and interoperability for healthcare systems in South Dakota.
items.curatedReason: 此新闻是关于南达科他州通用医疗IT现代化和互操作性的拨款，与物理治疗的临床执业或行业发展无直接关联。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款9000万美元用于南达科他州IT现代化和互操作性改善
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款9000万美元，旨在改善南达科他州的医疗信息技术现代化和互操作性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news is about a grant for general healthcare IT modernization and interoperability in South Dakota, which is not directly related to physical therapy clinical practice or industry development.

items.title: Inspiratory Strength Training in Pediatric Cardiac Critical Care: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study evaluated the feasibility, safety, and physiological response to inspiratory strength training (IST) in children with congenital heart disease in a pediatric cardiac intensive care unit. The study found IST to be feasible and safe, with patients completing at least one session.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提示吸气肌训练在儿童心脏重症监护室中是可行且安全的。虽然证据等级不高，但该研究为你的重症儿童患者康复策略提供了一个值得探索的方向。
items.titleZh: 儿童心脏重症监护中吸气肌力量训练的回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究评估了在儿科心脏重症监护室中，对先天性心脏病儿童进行吸气肌力量训练（IST）的可行性、安全性和生理反应。研究发现 IST 是可行且安全的，患者至少完成了一次训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests inspiratory strength training is feasible and safe in pediatric cardiac critical care. While the evidence level is not high, it provides a valuable direction for your rehabilitation strategies in critically ill pediatric patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，且缺乏对照组，无法确立因果关系或评估真实疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study lacking a control group, thus unable to establish causality or evaluate true efficacy.

items.title: Direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behaviour in hospitals: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and synthesized direct observation methods used for assessing inpatient movement behavior at the ward level, aiming to enhance methodological clarity for evaluating physical activity interventions in hospital settings.
items.curatedReason: 评估住院患者运动行为，直接观察是常用手段，但这项综述明确指出目前尚无统一的标准化方案。设计院内活动干预研究时，你需要了解现有方法的广度，但务必记得自行验证所选工具在你特定环境下的可靠性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 直接观察法评估住院患者运动行为的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并综合了在病房层面评估住院患者运动行为的直接观察方法，旨在提升住院环境物理活动干预评估的方法学清晰度。
items.curatedReasonEn: For assessing inpatient movement, direct observation is common, but this review confirms a lack of standardized, unified methods. When designing ward-level activity interventions, you need to understand the range of existing approaches, but be sure to validate your chosen tool's reliability and validity within your specific clinical setting.
items.limitation: 本综述仅关注观察方法，未能评估这些方法的测量学质量或提供标准化的协议。
items.limitationEn: This review focused solely on observation methods and did not assess the psychometric quality of these methods or provide standardized protocols.

items.title: Beyond the Diagnosis: An Integrated Perspective on Strategic Dosing in Neurologic Motor Rehabilitation. A Scoping Review and Collaborative Viewpoint.
items.summary: A scoping review synthesizing 42 studies identified a clinical need for a mechanism-based framework to guide therapeutic reasoning and dosing in neurorehabilitation, supporting broad distinctions between higher-intensity approaches for non-progressive conditions and conservative strategies for progressive conditions.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述提供了神经康复“剂量”策略的综合视角。它强调了从静态、诊断驱动的康复协议转向基于机制和个体化的剂量调整，尤其是在区分渐进性与非渐进性神经疾病时的强度设定。虽然没有标准化参数，但它会促使你反思当前康复方案的剂量设置。
items.titleZh: 超越诊断：神经运动康复中策略性剂量给定的综合视角——一项范围综述与协同观点
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述综合了 42 项研究，指出神经康复中急需一个基于机制的框架来指导治疗推理和剂量给定，并支持对非渐进性疾病采用更高强度方法，而对渐进性疾病采取更保守策略的广泛区分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review offers an integrated perspective on 'dosing' strategies in neurorehabilitation. It highlights the shift from static, diagnosis-driven protocols to mechanism-based and individualized dosing, particularly in setting intensity for progressive versus non-progressive neurological conditions. While not providing standardized parameters, it will prompt you to reconsider the dosing of your current rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 该范围综述未收敛出标准化的剂量参数，多数研究支持的只是广泛的强度区分。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review did not converge on standardized dosing parameters, with most studies only supporting broad distinctions in intensity.

items.title: A systematic review of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for post-stroke mobility prognostication.
items.summary: A systematic review identified early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers measured within 14 days post-stroke that predict mobility outcomes up to 24 months, with varying prognostic capacities across different statistical approaches.
items.curatedReason: 这篇系统综述告诉你，哪些早期影像学和神经生理生物标志物能帮你预测卒中患者的未来活动能力。它强调了哪些标志物在预测短期和长期功能恢复方面有更高价值，能指导你更精准地设定康复目标和规划干预。关注其在运动功能判别上的高价值发现。
items.titleZh: 早期神经影像学和神经生理生物标志物预测卒中后活动能力的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，在卒中后 14 天内测量的早期神经影像学和神经生理生物标志物能预测长达 24 个月的活动能力结局，但不同统计分析方法的预测效能各异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review identifies early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for predicting post-stroke mobility. It highlights which biomarkers have greater value in predicting short-term and long-term functional recovery, guiding you in setting more precise rehabilitation goals and intervention planning. Pay attention to its high-value findings in discriminating motor function.
items.limitation: 该综述主要限于观察性研究，且不同生物标志物的报告方法和统计分析异质性较高。
items.limitationEn: The review is primarily limited to observational studies, with high heterogeneity in reporting methods and statistical analyses across different biomarkers.

items.title: Survey on stroke rehabilitation in Europe (SUSTAIN-EU) to evaluate European stroke rehabilitation services.
items.summary: A cross-sectional online survey of 30 European countries assessed the organization and delivery of post-stroke rehabilitation services, revealing both commonalities and disparities, with stroke unit rehabilitation available in 90% of countries.
items.curatedReason: 欧洲卒中康复的组织和提供存在显著差异，但90%的国家已提供卒中单元康复。尽管只是观察性研究，但它提示我们应审视自身机构的服务模式，尤其在康复服务水平、登记系统和质量控制上，是否有向国际实践看齐的空间。
items.titleZh: 欧洲卒中康复调查（SUSTAIN-EU）评估欧洲卒中康复服务
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 个欧洲国家进行的在线横断面调查评估了卒中后康复服务的组织和提供情况，揭示了共性与差异，其中 90% 的国家提供卒中单元康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: While 90% of European countries offer stroke unit rehabilitation, the organization and delivery of post-stroke services vary significantly. This observational study suggests you should evaluate your own institution's service model, particularly in rehabilitation service levels, registry systems, and quality control, to align with international practices.

items.title: Effectiveness of a Personalized Robot-Assisted Trunk and Lower Limb Rehabilitation in Patients with Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This RCT with 40 chronic stroke patients found that 3 months of personalized robot-assisted trunk and lower limb training, combined with conventional rehabilitation, significantly improved Functional Ambulatory Category (FAC) compared to conventional rehabilitation alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，新型躯干-下肢康复机器人能显著改善慢性卒中患者的步行功能。这意味着你未来可以考虑将其作为常规康复的有效补充，尤其是在提升独立行走能力方面。
items.titleZh: 个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢康复对慢性卒中患者的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 40 名慢性卒中患者的随机对照试验发现，为期 3 个月的个性化机器人辅助躯干-下肢训练联合常规康复，在改善功能性步行分类 (FAC) 方面显著优于单独常规康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that a new trunk-lower limb rehabilitation robot significantly improves walking function in chronic stroke patients. This means you can consider it an effective supplement to conventional rehabilitation in the future, especially for improving independent ambulation.
items.limitation: 研究对象为慢性卒中患者，结果不一定适用于急性期或亚急性期卒中患者。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were patients with chronic stroke, and the results may not be applicable to patients in the acute or subacute phases of stroke.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 142 articles explored the effectiveness and optimal dosage of physical exercise on cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析确认了运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者认知功能的积极影响，特别是对某些认知领域。这坐实了运动疗法在 AD 管理中的关键地位，请确保将其纳入你的干预计划。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者的疗效：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 142 篇文章的系统综述和荟萃分析，旨在探讨身体运动对阿尔茨海默病老年患者认知功能的有效性和最佳剂量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis confirms the positive impact of exercise interventions on cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease, particularly for specific cognitive domains. The critical role of exercise therapy in AD management is undeniable, so ensure it is included in your intervention plans.
items.limitation: 综述指出，尽管有大量文献，但运动对特定认知领域的效果和最佳剂量仍有待进一步明确。
items.limitationEn: The review notes that despite substantial literature, the effectiveness of exercise on specific cognitive domains and optimal dosage remains to be confirmed.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 50 patients found that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the elastic coefficient of the dermis in limb oedema compared to 0% tension taping by day 9, as measured by shear-wave elastography.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 50 例患者的 RCT 首次通过剪切波弹性成像量化证实，25% 张力的肌内效贴在第 9 天能显著减少肢体水肿的真皮弹性系数。这为你在临床上处理严重依赖性肢体水肿提供了一个有效且可量化的新手段。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴对严重依赖性肢体水肿患者的疗效：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 50 名肢体水肿患者的随机临床试验发现，与 0% 张力肌内效贴相比，25% 张力肌内效贴在第 9 天显著降低了真皮层的弹性系数，提示其能有效减少肢体水肿。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT is the first to quantitatively confirm, via shear-wave elastography, that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduces limb edema in severe hyper-dependency. This provides you with an effective and quantifiable new tool for managing such edema in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间较短（最长 16 天），对长期效果和不同水肿类型（如淋巴水肿）的普适性需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period (maximum 16 days), and further research is needed on long-term effects and generalizability to different edema types (e.g., lymphedema).

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: This multicenter retrospective study in 200 women found the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 (PFDI-20) to be responsive, determining its smallest detectable change (SDC) and minimal important change (MIC) following 8 weeks of pelvic floor muscle training.
items.curatedReason: 有了土耳其语版 PFDI-20 的响应性、SDC 和 MIC 数据，你就能更精准地评估土耳其语患者盆底肌训练的临床改善。将这些数据作为评估保守治疗效果的量化依据。
items.titleZh: 盆底肌训练后土耳其语版盆底功能障碍问卷-20 的响应性、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心回顾性研究在 200 名女性中评估了土耳其语版盆底功能障碍问卷-20 (PFDI-20) 在盆底肌训练后的响应性，并确定了其最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: With the responsiveness, SDC, and MIC data for the Turkish PFDI-20, you can more accurately assess clinical improvement in Turkish-speaking patients undergoing pelvic floor muscle training. Use these metrics as a quantitative basis for evaluating conservative treatment outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性设计，可能存在选择偏倚和数据记录不完整的问题。
items.limitationEn: This study was retrospective, potentially introducing selection bias and incomplete data recording.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: A study with 21 participants showed that subacromial injection providing immediate pain relief in subacromial pain syndrome increased activity in select shoulder muscles during humeral elevation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，肩峰下注射镇痛后，部分肩部肌肉活动会即刻增加。这可能支持疼痛减轻后早期恢复主动运动训练的策略，但还需进一步研究明确其长期临床意义。
items.titleZh: 肩峰下疼痛综合征患者肩峰下注射镇痛后特定肩部肌肉活动增加
items.summaryZh: 一项对 21 名肩峰下疼痛综合征患者的研究显示，在肩峰下注射提供即刻镇痛后，部分肩部肌肉在肱骨抬高过程中的活动性有所增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that certain shoulder muscle activity immediately increases following subacromial injection for pain relief. This may support a strategy of early resumption of active exercise after pain reduction, but further research is needed to clarify its long-term clinical significance.
items.limitation: 样本量较小 (n=21)，且研究中存在肌电信号变异和记录错误。
items.limitationEn: The sample size was small (n=21), and there were EMG signal variability and recording errors in the study.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study assessed the reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain calculation methods using performance-based tests in 111 knee osteoarthritis patients, providing data on their test-retest reliability, SEM, and SDC.
items.curatedReason: 针对膝骨关节炎患者，这项研究提供了三种运动诱发疼痛评估方法的信效度数据。根据其可靠性、SEM 和 SDC 结果，在临床实践中选择最适合监测患者疼痛变化的工具。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛评估方法的信度和结构效度
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了 111 名膝骨关节炎患者中三种运动诱发疼痛计算方法（基于功能测试）的信度和结构效度，并提供了其重测信度、测量标准误 (SEM) 和最小可检测变化 (SDC) 的数据。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee osteoarthritis patients, this study provides reliability and construct validity data for three movement-evoked pain assessment methods. Based on their reliability, SEM, and SDC results, select the most suitable tool for monitoring patient pain changes in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性纵向研究的二次分析，可能存在原始数据收集偏差或未考虑混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This study was a secondary analysis of an observational longitudinal study, potentially subject to original data collection biases or unaddressed confounders.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review explored existing characteristics and definitions of classified gait pattern subgroups following stroke, highlighting ongoing uncertainties despite the importance of individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述强调了卒中后偏瘫步态模式分类的复杂性，提示你目前仍缺乏统一的定义和特征描述。在制定个性化步态训练方案时，请警惕现有分类体系的局限性，并持续关注新证据。
items.titleZh: 卒中后分类步态模式亚组的特征及异常步态模式定义：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统探讨了卒中后偏瘫步态模式亚组的现有特征和异常步态模式的定义，发现相关分类标准和特征描述仍存在不确定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights the complexity of classifying hemiplegic gait patterns post-stroke, indicating a lack of uniform definitions and characteristics. When developing personalized gait training programs, be aware of the limitations of current classification systems and stay informed about new evidence.
items.limitation: 本综述未提供具体步态模式亚组的分类标准或临床特征数据，仅指出其不确定性。
items.limitationEn: This review did not provide specific classification criteria or clinical characteristic data for gait pattern subgroups, only highlighting their uncertainty.

items.title: Ethics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Stroke Rehabilitation.
items.summary: This article discusses the ethical implications of artificial intelligence (AI) in stroke rehabilitation, addressing considerations such as patient privacy, data security, and responsible implementation.
items.curatedReason: 引入 AI 工具时，务必关注卒中康复中的患者隐私、数据安全和决策透明度。本文探讨的伦理问题提示我们，应警惕 AI 技术在临床应用中的潜在风险和责任边界。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在卒中康复中的伦理
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了人工智能 (AI) 在卒中康复中的伦理问题，涉及患者隐私、数据安全和负责任的实施等方面的考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: When introducing AI tools, prioritize patient privacy, data security, and decision transparency in stroke rehabilitation. The ethical issues discussed in this article remind us to be vigilant about the potential risks and boundaries of responsibility when applying AI in clinical settings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Relationship Between Physiological Mirror Activity and Corticomuscular Coherence During a Finger Dexterity Task Among Healthy Young and Older Adults
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 31 young and 24 older adults explored the relationship between physiological mirror activity (pMA) and corticomuscular coherence (CMC) during a left-hand finger dexterity task, finding that pMA was negatively correlated with gamma-band CMC in both groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项对 31 名年轻人和 24 名老年人进行的观察研究提示，生理性镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性在手指灵巧任务中存在负相关。这有助于你更好地理解神经康复中对侧肢体运动控制的神经生理机制，为制定干预策略提供参考。
items.titleZh: 健康青年和老年人手指灵巧任务中生理性镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项对 31 名青年和 24 名老年人进行的横断面研究，探讨了左手手指灵巧任务中生理性镜像活动 (pMA) 与皮层肌肉相干性 (CMC) 的关系，发现两组的 pMA 均与伽马波段 CMC 呈负相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study elucidates the relationship between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence during finger dexterity tasks in young and older adults. This helps you better understand the neurophysiological mechanisms of contralateral limb motor control in neurorehabilitation, providing a reference for intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且受试者样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This study was a cross-sectional design, preventing the establishment of causality, and the sample size was relatively small.

items.title: Foot-Targeted Rehabilitation for Pronation-Related Anterior Knee Pain: A Two-Phase Case-Control Study and Single-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial of Manual Therapy Versus Neuromuscular Training Each With Augmented Low-Dye Taping.
items.summary: A two-phase study including an RCT compared foot-targeted physiotherapy for pronation-related anterior knee pain, finding that manual therapy with augmented low-dye taping and neuromuscular training with ALDT were both more effective than routine physiotherapy care in the short term.
items.curatedReason: 足部干预对前膝痛的短期效果研究表明，手法治疗加低染料贴布和神经肌肉训练加低染料贴布均优于常规物理治疗。这提示你在处理此类患者时，应考虑纳入针对足部的干预。
items.titleZh: 针对旋前相关前膝痛的足部康复：一项两阶段病例对照研究与单盲随机对照试验，比较手法治疗与神经肌肉训练均结合强化低染料贴布
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究，包括一项随机对照试验，比较了针对旋前相关前膝痛的足部物理治疗方案。结果发现，手法治疗加强化低染料贴布和神经肌肉训练加强化低染料贴布在短期内均优于常规物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: Research on short-term effects of foot interventions for anterior knee pain indicates that both manual therapy with augmented low-dye taping and neuromuscular training with ALDT are superior to routine physiotherapy. This suggests considering foot-targeted interventions for these patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为两阶段设计，但关键的随机对照试验部分样本量未明确提供，且仅评估了短期效果。
items.limitationEn: This study employed a two-phase design, but the sample size for the key randomized controlled trial portion was not explicitly provided, and only short-term effects were evaluated.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of In-Clinic Rehabilitation vs. Home-Based Telerehabilitation for Adults with MS in the Deep South: The TEAMS Cluster Randomized Trial.
items.summary: The TEAMS cluster randomized trial (n=759) found that a 12-week complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program for multiple sclerosis delivered via home-based telerehabilitation was as effective as in-clinic rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: TEAMS 随机对照试验显示，针对多发性硬化症患者的家庭远程康复与诊所内康复效果相似。这坐实了远程康复在某些慢性神经系统疾病中的应用潜力，你可以将其作为扩大患者可及性的重要工具。
items.titleZh: 美国深南部多发性硬化症成人诊所内康复与居家远程康复的疗效比较：TEAMS 群组随机试验
items.summaryZh: TEAMS 群组随机试验（n=759）发现，针对多发性硬化症患者为期12周的补充与替代医学（CAM）项目，通过居家远程康复与诊所内康复的效果相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TEAMS cluster randomized trial shows that home-based telerehabilitation for multiple sclerosis patients is as effective as in-clinic rehabilitation. This confirms the potential of telerehabilitation for certain chronic neurological conditions, and you can leverage it as a key tool for expanding patient accessibility.
items.limitation: 该研究主要关注补充和替代医学（CAM）项目，结果外推到其他类型康复方案时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focused on a complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program, and caution is needed when generalizing the results to other rehabilitation interventions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=28) found that functional physiotherapy (pain science education, cognition-targeted exercises) and conventional physiotherapy (TENS, bladder training) similarly improved symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 功能性与传统物理治疗在膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者中的疗效相似，都对症状和生活质量有益。提示你应优先选择患者依从性高的干预方案。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者症状、心理结局及生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=28）发现，功能性物理治疗（疼痛科学教育、认知导向运动）与传统物理治疗（经皮神经电刺激、膀胱训练）在改善膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者的症状、心理结局及生活质量方面效果相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional and conventional physiotherapy show similar efficacy in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome, benefiting symptoms and quality of life. This suggests prioritizing interventions with higher patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（28名患者），且未明确报告随访时长和长期效应。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (28 patients) and did not clearly report follow-up duration or long-term effects.

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored experiences of telehealth e-mentoring in postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom, identifying perceived outcomes and challenges in developing advanced practice capabilities.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制度为物理治疗研究生教育提供了新策略，尤其在加拿大和英国的肌骨康复领域。这提示你可以将此模式纳入你的教学或专业发展中，以支持高级实践能力培养。
items.titleZh: 加拿大和英国肌骨物理治疗研究生教育中远程电子导师制度的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大和英国肌骨物理治疗研究生教育中远程电子导师制度的经验，识别了在发展高级实践能力方面的感知结果与挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring offers a novel strategy for postgraduate physiotherapy education, especially in musculoskeletal rehabilitation in Canada and the UK. This suggests you could integrate this model into your teaching or professional development to foster advanced practice capabilities.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性设计，依赖受访者的主观经验，结果不具有量化推断性。
items.limitationEn: This study used a qualitative design, relying on subjective experiences of participants, and its findings are not quantitatively generalizable.

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of the breakfast group intervention BISTRo for stroke survivors in acute rehabilitation.
items.summary: A multisite mixed-methods feasibility study examined the feasibility and acceptability of the co-designed BISTRo breakfast group intervention for stroke survivors in acute rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 早餐小组干预 BISTRo 在急性卒中康复中显示出可行性和可接受性。虽然只是可行性研究，但这提示你可以在急性期康复中探索整合社交和多学科功能的创新模式，以提升患者参与度。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者急性康复中早餐小组干预 BISTRo 的可行性与可接受性
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心混合方法可行性研究，旨在评估卒中幸存者急性康复中共同设计的 BISTRo 早餐小组干预的可行性和可接受性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The breakfast group intervention BISTRo demonstrated feasibility and acceptability in acute stroke rehabilitation. While only a feasibility study, this suggests you can explore innovative models integrating social and multidisciplinary functions in acute rehabilitation to enhance patient engagement.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，仅关注干预的可行性和可接受性，未评估其临床有效性。
items.limitationEn: This was a feasibility study, focusing only on the intervention's feasibility and acceptability, not its clinical effectiveness.

items.title: Methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review systematically mapped and characterized the methodological features of mechanically induced perturbation-based balance training interventions in healthy older adults, aiming to inform fall prevention strategies.
items.curatedReason: 设计健康老年人扰动平衡训练时，这份综述值得你参考。它系统梳理了现有研究的方法学特征，有助于你制定更具体、有效的跌倒预防方案。
items.titleZh: 基于扰动的平衡训练在健康老年人中的方法学特征：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统地梳理并描述了基于机械扰动的平衡训练在健康老年人中的方法学特征，旨在为跌倒预防策略提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically mapped the methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults. This provides you with a comprehensive methodological reference for designing fall prevention programs, helping optimize perturbation training parameters and implementation strategies.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质决定了它主要进行文献梳理，不提供干预效果的量化汇总或因果推断。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review means it primarily maps existing literature and does not provide quantitative synthesis of intervention effects or causal inferences.

items.title: Systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain: Refining the mechanistic lens.
items.summary: This commentary refines the mechanistic understanding of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain by exploring the role of systemic inflammation as a mediator.
items.curatedReason: 这项评论性文章从机制层面探讨了系统性炎症在运动对慢性腰痛益处中的中介作用。这提示你对慢性腰痛的运动处方应更深层次地理解其生理机制，而不止于生物力学。
items.titleZh: 系统性炎症作为慢性腰痛运动益处的中介：细化机制视角
items.summaryZh: 本评论文章通过探讨系统性炎症在慢性腰痛运动益处中的中介作用，细化了对运动益处的机制理解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary explores the mechanistic role of systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain. This suggests a deeper understanding of the physiological mechanisms, beyond just biomechanics, is needed for exercise prescriptions in chronic low back pain.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 14 patients explored perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management, revealing that patients prioritize clear symptom explanations, value clinicians who listen, and place high faith in exercise.
items.curatedReason: 患者对肩袖肌腱病管理的观点强调了运动治疗的信念以及清晰的症状解释。这提示你在临床实践中，应重视与患者的沟通，并解释治疗方案以建立信任和依从性。
items.titleZh: “我现在真的只相信运动疗法了”：肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对14名患者进行的定性研究探讨了他们对肩袖肌腱病管理的看法，揭示患者优先考虑清晰的症状解释，重视倾听的临床医生，并高度信任运动疗法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management highlight their belief in exercise therapy and the importance of clear symptom explanations. This suggests you should prioritize communication with patients and explain treatment plans to build trust and adherence in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（14名患者），发现不具有普遍推论性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (14 patients), and its findings are not broadly generalizable.

items.title: Development and Content Validation of an Exercise-Based Framework for the Management of Lumbar Radiculopathy.
items.summary: This study developed and content-validated an exercise-based framework for the management of lumbar radiculopathy, integrating evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise.
items.curatedReason: 针对腰椎神经根病变开发的运动框架，整合了多种循证运动方法和临床专业知识。这为你的腰椎神经根病变患者管理提供了一个结构化的思考路径，有助于优化治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 腰椎神经根病变运动管理框架的开发与内容验证
items.summaryZh: 本研究开发并内容验证了一个用于腰椎神经根病变管理的运动框架，整合了循证运动方法和临床专业知识。
items.curatedReasonEn: An exercise-based framework developed for lumbar radiculopathy integrates various evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise. This provides a structured thought process for managing your lumbar radiculopathy patients, helping optimize treatment plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为框架开发和内容验证，未提供临床疗效的直接证据。
items.limitationEn: This study focused on framework development and content validation, and does not provide direct evidence of clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Upper-Limb Paresis Severity Is Associated With Practice Dosage During Task-Oriented Training in Subacute Stroke-An Exploratory Secondary Analysis.
items.summary: An exploratory secondary analysis (n=33) found that upper-limb paresis severity is associated with the practice dosage achieved during task-oriented training in individuals with subacute stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，上肢麻痹严重程度与卒中后任务导向训练的练习剂量相关。这表明你在为亚急性卒中患者制定训练计划时，应根据患者的麻痹程度调整期望的练习量。
items.titleZh: 上肢麻痹严重程度与亚急性卒中任务导向训练的练习剂量相关：一项探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性二次分析（n=33）发现，上肢麻痹严重程度与亚急性卒中患者任务导向训练中达到的练习剂量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that upper-limb paresis severity is associated with practice dosage during task-oriented training post-stroke. This indicates you should adjust expected practice volumes based on the patient's paresis severity when planning training for subacute stroke patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为事后探索性分析，样本量较小（33名患者），且为单中心研究，结果需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a post-hoc exploratory analysis with a small sample size (33 patients) and a single-center study, so the results require further validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Impacts of ankle sprain on functional performance in under-20 soccer players: a cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=75) compared functional and biomechanical parameters in under-20 soccer players with and without a history of lateral ankle sprain, finding that sprain history negatively impacts functional performance.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究发现，踝关节扭伤史会对青少年足球运动员的功能表现产生负面影响。这意味着你在评估和康复年轻运动员时，应特别关注有踝关节扭伤史的个体，加强预防性训练。
items.titleZh: 踝关节扭伤对20岁以下足球运动员功能表现的影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究（n=75）比较了有无外侧踝关节扭伤史的20岁以下足球运动员的功能和生物力学参数，发现扭伤史对功能表现有负面影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study found that a history of ankle sprain negatively impacts functional performance in under-20 soccer players. This implies that when assessing and rehabilitating young athletes, you should pay particular attention to individuals with a history of ankle sprains and enhance preventive training.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且所有受试者均为巴西男性青少年足球运动员，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and all participants were male adolescent soccer players from Brazil, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Current Manual Therapy Practices in Pediatric Neurological Physiotherapy: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey (n=61) in Greece described current manual therapy practices among pediatric neurological physiotherapists, finding that 55.7% use it primarily as an adjunct intervention, most effective for joint mobility.
items.curatedReason: 希腊儿科神经物理治疗师使用手法治疗的现状调查显示，近六成从业者将其作为辅助干预。这提示你在儿童神经康复中，可以考虑将手法治疗作为提高关节活动度和疼痛管理的辅助手段，但需结合患者具体情况。
items.titleZh: 儿科神经物理治疗中手法治疗的当前实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项在希腊进行的横断面调查（n=61）描述了儿科神经物理治疗师目前的手法治疗实践，发现55.7%的受访者主要将其作为辅助干预手段，对关节活动度最有效。
items.curatedReasonEn: A survey on manual therapy use among pediatric neurological physiotherapists in Greece indicates that nearly 60% use it as an adjunctive intervention. This suggests that in pediatric neurological rehabilitation, you might consider manual therapy as an adjunct to improve joint mobility and pain management, while considering the patient's specific condition.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，依赖受访者的自我报告，存在回忆偏差和主观性。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey relies on self-reported data from participants, which may be subject to recall bias and subjectivity.

items.title: The Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose for Blood Pressure Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Systematic Review with Bayesian Model-Based, and Dose-Response Network Meta-Analysis of RCTs.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of RCTs found that for middle-aged and older adults, combined aerobic and resistance training, with sufficient volume, was most effective for lowering systolic and diastolic blood pressure, outperforming other modalities.
items.curatedReason: 别再只推单一运动降压了，中老年人合并有氧和抗阻训练，且保证一定训练量（如每周 150 分钟中等强度），才是降低收缩压和舒张压的王道。
items.titleZh: 中老年人血压管理最佳运动模式与剂量：一项包含贝叶斯模型和剂量-反应网络荟萃分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于中老年人血压管理的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，结合有氧和抗阻训练，达到一定训练量时，降血压效果最佳，优于其他模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stop recommending single exercise modes for blood pressure reduction. For middle-aged and older adults, combined aerobic and resistance training with sufficient volume (e.g., 150 minutes/week moderate intensity) is the gold standard for lowering both systolic and diastolic blood pressure.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的 RCT 异质性较高，可能影响荟萃分析结果的精度。
items.limitationEn: The included RCTs exhibit high heterogeneity, potentially affecting the precision of the meta-analysis results.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of exercise-based prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of RCTs comparing prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty (TKA) found that multimodal exercise programs were more effective than single modalities, suggesting a comprehensive approach for better outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 全膝关节置换术 (TKA) 前的术前康复，别再纠结单项功能训练了，这项系统综述和网络荟萃分析提示，多模式联合方案（耐力、力量、平衡、功能训练）效果更佳。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术前运动基康复的比较有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项比较全膝关节置换术前运动基康复的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，多模式运动方案比单一模式更有效，提示应采取综合性方法以获得更好的结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty (TKA), move beyond single-modality training. This systematic review and network meta-analysis suggests that multimodal, combined programs (endurance, strength, balance, functional training) yield superior outcomes.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究在运动方案、持续时间和强度上存在异质性，限制了直接比较。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in exercise protocols, duration, and intensity across included studies limits direct comparisons.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of combined balance and plyometric training on athletic performance: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review found that combined balance and plyometric training significantly improves athletic performance, highlighting its effectiveness in enhancing explosive power, agility, and dynamic stability for athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述表明，结合平衡与增强式训练可以显著提高运动员的运动表现。这为 PT 提供了有力证据，支持在运动专项训练中纳入结合这两种训练模式的方案，以提升爆发力、敏捷性和稳定性。
items.titleZh: 结合平衡与增强式训练对运动表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，结合平衡与增强式训练可显著提高运动表现，强调其在增强爆发力、敏捷性和动态稳定性方面的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review demonstrates that combined balance and plyometric training significantly enhances athletic performance. This provides strong evidence for PTs to incorporate both training modalities into sport-specific programs to improve explosive power, agility, and stability.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的训练方案和评估方法存在异质性，可能影响结果的精确度。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in training protocols and assessment methods across included studies may affect the precision of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of different aerobic exercise intensities on exercise capacity, quality of life and mortality in individuals with coronary artery disease: systematic review and network meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis found that moderate-intensity aerobic exercise may be the most effective for improving exercise capacity, quality of life, and mortality in individuals with coronary artery disease (CAD).
items.curatedReason: 对于冠心病 (CAD) 患者，这项高质量系统综述提示，在改善运动能力、生活质量和降低死亡率方面，中等强度有氧运动效果最佳。制定心脏康复计划时，你现在可以更明确地推荐中等强度。
items.titleZh: 不同有氧运动强度对冠心病患者运动能力、生活质量和死亡率的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，中等强度的有氧运动可能最有效地改善冠心病 (CAD) 患者的运动能力、生活质量和死亡率。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), this high-quality systematic review suggests moderate-intensity aerobic exercise is likely optimal for improving exercise capacity, quality of life, and mortality. When designing cardiac rehab, you now have strong evidence to prioritize moderate intensity.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的训练强度定义可能存在差异，对网络荟萃分析结果的精确性产生影响。
items.limitationEn: Variations in the definition of exercise intensity across included studies might impact the precision of the network meta-analysis results.

items.title: Effect of six weeks of ankle stretching exercises on ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that six weeks of ankle stretching exercises significantly improved ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and reduced anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 研究表明，为期六周的踝关节牵伸训练可以显著改善儿童踝关节背屈活动度，并可能减轻前膝痛。这为 PT 提供了具体的干预手段，以解决与儿童踝关节过度内旋相关的膝痛问题。
items.titleZh: 六周踝关节牵伸运动对儿童踝关节过度内旋引起的踝关节背屈活动度和前膝痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，六周的踝关节牵伸运动可显著改善儿童踝关节过度内旋患者的踝关节背屈活动度，并减轻前膝痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that six weeks of ankle stretching exercises significantly improve ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and may reduce anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation. This provides PTs with a specific intervention to address knee pain related to pediatric ankle overpronation.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注了六周的短期效果，长期效益和对其他步态参数的影响尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on short-term effects over six weeks; long-term benefits and effects on other gait parameters remain unclear.

items.title: Differences in the Thoracolumbar Fascia Between Low Back Pain Patients and Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found differences in the thoracolumbar fascia (TLF) between low back pain patients and healthy individuals, suggesting the TLF plays a role in LBP and warrants further investigation into its pathophysiology and targeted interventions.
items.curatedReason: 腰痛患者的胸腰筋膜 (TLF) 确实与健康人不同，但这离说清楚 TLF 是腰痛主因还差得远。目前还需更多研究来阐明其具体病理生理机制和靶向干预方法。
items.titleZh: 腰痛患者与健康个体胸腰筋膜的差异：一项含荟萃分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项含荟萃分析的系统综述发现，腰痛患者与健康个体在胸腰筋膜 (TLF) 上存在差异，提示 TLF 在腰痛中起作用，并需要进一步研究其病理生理和靶向干预。
items.curatedReasonEn: The thoracolumbar fascia (TLF) in low back pain (LBP) patients differs from healthy individuals, but this is a long way from proving TLF as the primary cause of LBP. More research is needed to elucidate specific pathophysiological mechanisms and targeted interventions.
items.limitation: TLF 的测量方法和定义在纳入的研究中存在异质性，可能影响荟萃分析结果。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in measurement methods and definitions of the TLF across included studies may affect meta-analysis results.

items.title: The effect of SportsMetrics training program on functional performance, landing error, dynamic knee valgus and hamstrings/quadriceps strength in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that the SportsMetrics training program effectively improves functional performance, reduces landing errors and dynamic knee valgus, and enhances hamstring/quadriceps strength in athletes, supporting its role in injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: SportsMetrics 训练计划是靠谱的。这项系统综述和荟萃分析证实，它能有效改善运动员的功能表现，减少落地失误和膝外翻，并增强股四头肌/腘绳肌力量，确实是预防运动损伤的利器。
items.titleZh: SportsMetrics 训练计划对运动员功能表现、落地误差、动态膝外翻及腘绳肌/股四头肌力量的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，SportsMetrics 训练计划能有效改善运动员的功能表现，减少落地误差和动态膝外翻，并增强腘绳肌/股四头肌力量，支持其在运动损伤预防中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SportsMetrics training program is reliable. This systematic review and meta-analysis confirms its effectiveness in improving athletic functional performance, reducing landing errors and dynamic knee valgus, and enhancing hamstring/quadriceps strength, making it a valuable tool for injury prevention.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的异质性可能影响结果的精确性，需要对训练实施细节进行标准化。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity across included studies may affect the precision of the results, and standardization of training implementation details is needed.
